items.title: Frontend Dashboard权限提升
items.summary_zh: 低权限注册用户可利用该插件权限分配错误提升为管理员，进而完全接管WordPress站点。
items.action_zh: 升级插件至3.0.7之后版本；无法升级时停用该插件并限制用户注册。
items.description: Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in M A Vinoth Kumar Frontend Dashboard frontend-dashboard allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects Frontend Dashboard: from n/a through 3.0.7.

items.title: Affiliates插件反序列化对象注入
items.title_zh: Affiliates插件反序列化对象注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可向插件传入恶意序列化数据触发对象注入，可能进一步实现远程代码执行。
items.action_zh: 升级Affiliates插件至7.0.1以上；无法升级时先停用该插件。
items.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in itthinx Affiliates affiliates allows Object Injection.This issue affects Affiliates: from n/a through 7.0.1.

items.title: TR7 ASP缺失认证致命令注入
items.title_zh: TR7 ASP缺失认证致命令注入
items.summary_zh: 未授权远程攻击者可调用关键功能接口注入OS命令，以设备权限执行任意系统指令。
items.repro_note: 未授权访问关键功能接口，构造命令注入载荷，前置条件为受影响版本。
items.impact_scope: 内网安全设备，管理口暴露
items.description: Missing authentication for critical function vulnerability in TR7 Cyber ​​Defense Inc. TR7 ASP on virtual appliance and TR7 Cyber ​​Defense Inc. TR7 ASP on physical appliance allows OS Command Injection. This issue affects TR7 ASP: from 1.0.40.236 before 1.0.1554.2331; TR7 ASP: from 1.6.42.239 before 1.6.1554.2331.

items.title: TR7 ASP OS命令注入漏洞
items.title_zh: TR7 ASP OS命令注入漏洞
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可向受影响功能传入特制参数注入OS命令，以设备权限执行任意指令。
items.repro_note: 未授权请求受影响接口，在参数中拼接OS命令并观察回显或延时。
items.impact_scope: 内网安全设备，管理口暴露
items.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command ('OS command injection') vulnerability in TR7 Cyber ​​Defense Inc. TR7 ASP on virtual appliance and TR7 Cyber ​​Defense Inc. TR7 ASP on physical appliance allows OS Command Injection. This issue affects TR7 ASP: from 1.0.40.236 before 1.0.1554.2331; TR7 ASP: from 1.6.42.239 before 1.6.1554.2331.

items.title: WebAlliance SOAP接口SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者可向preapproval.asmx的sUserID注入SQL，读写库并可能执行系统命令。
items.action_zh: 限制该接口外网访问并过滤参数，联系厂商获取修复版本。
items.repro_note: 未授权POST /preapproval.asmx调用GetUser，sUserID传单引号与堆叠语句。
items.description: SQL Injection (CWE-89) in the SOAP GetUser method of the /preapproval.asmx endpoint in Channel Software WebAlliance eCommerce [VERSION — missing] allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to read, write, and potentially execute commands on the backend Microsoft SQL Server via a crafted sUserID parameter value containing a single quote and stacked SQL query.
